capabilities: Sync recent activities from Strava via the API
Import a Strava bulk export CSV of historical activities
Render imported activities with Handlebars.js templates
Configure which activity fields are written to front matter properties
Show per-sport icons for use with Iconize
extras: Notes that the bulk export CSV format differs from the API JSON format, so some fields are not imported; also suggests excluding the sync folder from Obsidian search and graph views.
motivation: The author states the purpose is to let activities be more easily referenced, tracked and visualized within Obsidian, especially through Dataview.
problem: Strava activities are hard to reference, track, and visualize inside Obsidian because there is no built-in way to pull them in as notes.

relations.evidence: the real power of this plugin comes from the Dataview integration
the ability to use the Charts plugin to visualize historical activity data
This example requires that the Contribution Graph plugin first be installed and enabled.
Per-sport icons for use with Iconize
It's also possible to install an unreleased (beta) version using the BRAT plugin

requires.name: Strava API Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Strava integration that imports activities via the Strava API or bulk-export CSV into templated notes with customizable front matter.
